description: This file implements functionality to remove unreferenced variables and struct types from an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) in the ANGLE project, including traversers for collecting reference counts and removing unreferenced variables.

classes.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser
classes.description: Traverser that collects reference counts for symbols and struct types in the AST.

classes.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser
classes.description: Traverser that removes variables and struct types that are unreferenced based on collected counts.

methods.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser::CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reference count traverser.

methods.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser::incrementStructTypeRefCount
methods.description: Increments reference count for struct types, including interface blocks.

methods.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Visits a symbol node and updates reference counts.

methods.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits an aggregate node and updates struct reference counts.

methods.name: CollectVariableRefCountsTraverser::visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Visits a function prototype and updates struct reference counts for parameters.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser
methods.description: Constructor for the removal traverser, initializing reference count maps.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::decrementStructTypeRefCount
methods.description: Decrements reference count for struct types, removing nested references if count reaches zero.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::removeVariableDeclaration
methods.description: Removes a variable declaration if it is unreferenced.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits variable declarations to determine if they can be removed.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Updates reference counts when a symbol is visited during removal.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Updates struct reference counts during aggregate node visits.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::traverseBlock
methods.description: Traverses a block in reverse order to facilitate variable removal.

methods.name: RemoveUnreferencedVariablesTraverser::traverseLoop
methods.description: Traverses a loop in reverse order for variable removal.
